sources.title: NASA The Apollo Program
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 國際太空站整合工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學需求 1450 m/s 時原案通過、增重案不足；尚需額外保留實際損失與裕度。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching requirement of 1450 m/s baseline passes and added mass fails; real losses and margins remain to be added. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用冷卻迴路熱量平衡檢查新增酬載能否由既有流量帶走。
related.differenceEn: Use a coolant-loop heat balance to assess removal of an added payload heat load.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學有效排氣速度 3000 m/s，燃燒前質量 10000 kg，後 6000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000)。 結果約 1532.48 m/s。理想 Δv=ve ln(m0/mf)，只計質量比；實際還有重力、操控與軌道損失。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成熱負載 4000 W、冷卻液比熱 4000 J/(kg K)、允許溫升 5 K。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ṁ=4000/(4000×5)。 結果約 0.2 kg/s。穩態 Q=ṁcpΔT；忽略相變與對外散熱，單位 W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching effective exhaust speed 3000 m/s, initial mass 10000 kg and final mass 6000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000). Result ≈ 1532.48 m/s. Ideal Δv=ve ln(m0/mf) captures mass ratio only; real flight includes gravity, steering and trajectory losses.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic load is 4000 W, coolant heat capacity 4000 J/(kg K) and allowed rise 5 K. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ṁ=4000/(4000×5). Result ≈ 0.2 kg/s. At steady state Q=ṁcpΔT, excluding phase change and external loss; W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 星鏈與低軌通訊星系
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學需求 1450 m/s 時原案通過、增重案不足；尚需額外保留實際損失與裕度。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching requirement of 1450 m/s baseline passes and added mass fails; real losses and margins remain to be added. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 拆解往返延遲，區分幾何下界與實測服務延遲。
related.differenceEn: Decompose round-trip latency and distinguish a geometric floor from measured service latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學有效排氣速度 3000 m/s，燃燒前質量 10000 kg，後 6000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000)。 結果約 1532.48 m/s。理想 Δv=ve ln(m0/mf)，只計質量比；實際還有重力、操控與軌道損失。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成高度 550 km、光速 300000 km/s、額外處理與排隊往返 12 ms。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：RTT=4×550/300000×1000+12。 結果約 19.3333 ms。教學兩段上／下行各 h，往返光程=4h；加處理排隊時間。真實斜距與路由通常更長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching effective exhaust speed 3000 m/s, initial mass 10000 kg and final mass 6000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000). Result ≈ 1532.48 m/s. Ideal Δv=ve ln(m0/mf) captures mass ratio only; real flight includes gravity, steering and trajectory losses.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic altitude is 550 km, light speed 300000 km/s and extra round-trip processing/queueing 12 ms. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: RTT=4×550/300000×1000+12. Result ≈ 19.3333 ms. For two vertical legs each h, round-trip path=4h; add processing/queue delay. Real slant ranges and routing are generally longer.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
